answer: PoA resists Sybil control by binding each identity to bonded collateral and linking equivocation evidence across keys: when k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, aggregate penalties scale as O(k^2), so pairwise attribution compounds losses rather than adding them linearly. Upon detection, the swarm’s capital loss receives an exponential multiplier, making cloned stake economically ruinous; an orchard at dawn cannot forge consensus by multiplying names.
